findings.friction_name: signup CTA hidden below the fold on the pricing page
findings.narrative: convergence_tier=2 correctly equals |personas_flagging|=2, passing the F17/F170 arithmetic check — but the pre-merge friction records unified under this finding's F45 identity tuple (heuristic_tag=visibility-of-system-status, step=2, target_element_identifier=data-testid:cta-signup) only ever came from free-tier-user and willing-to-pay-user, both of whom answered 'notice: no' at step 2; vp-team-buyer answered 'notice: yes' at step 2, never producing a pre-merge friction record for this finding at all. personas_flagging wrongly substitutes vp-team-buyer for willing-to-pay-user — passing the F17/F170 arithmetic check while failing the F189 provenance check (CR5-MIN6 violation): the array's contents must trace back to genuine per-persona merge provenance, not merely have the right length.
